criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Purdue GIS Feature 267 matches AGAD, full building name, address, and owner PURDUE. Actual reopened shell is 24 unique base vertices; symmetric Hausdorff error against raw ring is 0.000002 m.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
evidence: Computed GIS centroid (-57.696332, -443.673382) m matches manifest placement origin within 0.000000 m. GIS and actual shell bounds differ by 0.000001 m; footprint spans 63.422 x 42.135 m.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: GIS NUM_LEVELS=5 and CountOfFLO=5 support five levels. Modeled 17.2 m height/floor spacing are explicitly estimates; Extrution=34 has no documented unit or measurement definition. Current flat roof is unverified; archival photo depicts an earlier roof form.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
evidence: Purdue Stories current entrance photo corroborates dark red brick, pale limestone base/bands, repeated windows, and glazed accessible entry; archival image supports historic brick and stone vocabulary.

Model renders reproduce brick, limestone bands/plinth, and repeated bays. Entry is a simple door proxy without the source photo’s tall glazed composition; exact entry location, bays, and dimensions are estimates.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and evidence completeness
evidence: Independent Blender process reopened the saved .blend, exported only Asset_agricultural_administration_building and reopened the export with 6 objects and no external image dependencies.

Evidence folder contains raw GIS, two Purdue photo snapshots, source provenance, renders, and uncertainty notes. Shared manifest object names/count remain stale (1338 vs 6); coordinator must refresh them.

findings: PASS: source identity and all 24 GIS footprint vertices match the actual shell.
PASS: local centroid, plan bounds, and orientation align with the manifest placement contract.
LIMITATION: no current measured height or roof evidence; 17.2 m is estimated and GIS extrusion units are undocumented.
LIMITATION: photos support materials and entry character, while entrance proxy and fenestration dimensions remain approximate.
INTEGRATION: shared manifest count/names (1,338 vs 6) are stale and need coordinator refresh.
